<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Vaughan, 27 Oct 23:3x: 'fix it and do it' (brief: prime pij-broad-rykard). Baseline 23:43: 741 new processes/s machine-wide; the pij-rs daemon's children 250-480/s (~90% tmux, ~9% ps), the pij status line >=40/s; Defender ~1.7 cores (epsext 83%, wdavdaemon_enterprise 47%, wdavdaemon 27%, log 10%). Root causes: the pane observer forks show-options + display-message + capture-pane per tracked pane every 600 ms; liveness forks `ps` per check; the plan-156 status line forks ~20 per refresh and calls `pij-rs whoami`. Closes the daemon half of pij-fleet#62. Stacked on #71 so a deploy cannot drop Telegram files.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Steady-state pij reads launch no process.
- The status line is one process per refresh with identical bytes.
- Every answer stays the same; control mode is never worse than forking.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Changing what the observer, liveness or status line decide.
- Defender configuration (EDR cannot be excluded by users).
- The tmux plugin tomux/scripts/status.sh (not pij).
